If [del]p q[/del] (10m + 1)(10n + 1) = 10^p - 1
= 100 mn + 10(m+n) + 1
Then 100 mn + 10(m+n) = 10^p - 10
and 10 mn + m + n = 10^{p-1} - 1
and Either p = [del]p[/del] q
when (10^m + 1)(10^n + 1) = (10^p + 1)(10^q-1)
or p - 1 = 10q
10 mn + m + n = (10^q - 1)(10^q + 1)
